column2: Yamya, Mrityuhara, Dhata, Vidhata, Karyaranjaka, Kala, Dharma and Adharma, Samyokta and Viyogaka;
Nairrita, Marana, Hanta, of cruel gaze, terrible, Urdhvamshaka, Virupaksha, with smoky-red fangs;
Bala and Atibala, noose-handed, great-strong; Shveta and Jayabhadra, long-armed, Jalantaka;
Vadavasya and Bhima — these ten are remembered as Varunas: Shighra, Laghu, Vayuvega, Sukshma, Tikshna, Kshapantaka,
Panchantaka, Panchashikha, Kapardi, Meghavahana, bearer of a crown of matted hair, bearer of various jewels,
Nidhisha, Rupavan, Dhanya, of gentle body, giver of grace, Prakasha, Lakshmivan, Kamarupa — ten in the north;
Vidyadhara, Jnanadhara, Sarvajna, Vedaparaga, Matrivritta, Pingalaksha, Bhutapala, Balipriya,
Sarvavidyavidhata and Sukhaduhkhahara — ten; Ananta, Palaka, Dhira, and Patalaadhipati;
Vrisha, Vrishadhara, Virya, Grasana, Sarvatomukha and Lohita — these ten Rudras are to be known as stationed on the serpent.
Shambhu, Vibhu, Ganadhyaksha, Tryaksha, Tridashavandita, Samhara and Vihara, Labha, Lipsu, Vichakshana,
Atta, Kuhaka, Kalagnirudra and Hataka; Kushmanda and Satya, Brahma and Vishnu the seventh,
and Rudra — these eight Rudras are stationed within the cosmic shell. One should remember these very names also for the worlds.
Bhavodbhava, Sarvabhuta, giver of happiness to all beings, maker of presence everywhere, worshipped by Brahma, Vishnu and Rudra.

Praised, earlier-standing; Om witness; Om Rudrantaka; Om bird; Om sound; Om subtle; Om Shiva; giver of all, maker of presence everywhere, maker of Brahma, Vishnu and Rudra; Om homage to Shiva; Om homage, homage. Twenty-eight feet pervading space, mind, the cave; Sadyo, heart, missile, eyes — the eight mantra-letters are held;
the seed-form and the letter Ma; the channels called Ida and Pingala; prana and apana, both winds; nose and generative organ, likewise the senses;
smell is declared the object, in the five qualities beginning with smell. The earthen orb is yellow, thunderbolt-limbed, four-sided;
its breadth is a crore of yojanas multiplied by a hundred. Within this, the fourteen wombs are also to be known:
the first of all the gods: the divine wombs from Manu onward; beasts and birds, animals, and fourth reptiles;
the fifth is all immovable; the sixth womb is non-human: Pishacha, Rakshasa, Yaksha, Gandharva, and Indra's;
Saumya, Praneshvara, and Brahma, the eighth, are declared. Of the eight, the earth principle is held to be the seat of authority.
Dissolution is in nature, in intellect; enjoyment; and Brahma is the cause. Then with all the states of waking, with all worlds and the rest,

having meditated on Nivritti contained and united it with one's own mantra: "Om Ham Hrum Ham, to the bond of the digit Nivritti, hum phat" — then with "Om Ham Ham, to the bond of the digit Nivritti, svaha" having drawn by inhalation with the goad-mudra; with "Om Hrum Hram Hrum, to the bond of the digit Nivritti, hum phat," by the mudra of withdrawal, by retention taking from the lower place; with "Om Om Hram Ham, homage to the bond of the digit Nivritti," by the rising mudra, by exhalation placing in the pot; with "Om Ham, homage to the bond of the digit Nivritti," having given arghya and worshipped, with the face turned away with mantras ending in svaha, having given three oblations for presence and three oblations of satisfaction, with "Om Ham, homage to Brahma" having invoked Brahma and worshipped, satisfied with the one ending in svaha: "Brahma, in this your authority I shall initiate the seeker of liberation;
be favorable to us" — thus one should inform him of the rite. Then one should invoke the goddess Vagishvari for protection with the heart-mantra,
of the form of will, knowledge and action, sixfold, the one cause. One should worship and satisfy the goddess in this manner;
Vagishvari, the cause of agitating all wombs entirely; with the seed-syllable enclosed by the heart and ending in hum phat, with the arrow-atom,
one should strike on his heart and the one who knows the rule should enter. Then the disciple's consciousness, like a spark of fire in the heart,
abiding in Nivritti, joined with bonds, one should divide it with the eldest; "Om Ham Hum Hah Hum phat Om Ham svaha" by this, then by inhalation with the goad-mudra

having drawn it, having taken with one's own mantra, one should unite it to the Self: "Om Ham Hrum Ham, homage to the Self"; having imagined the union of the parents, one should exhale that consciousness,
having led it by the order of abandoning the cause beginning with Brahma to Shiva's abode; having taken it for impregnation simultaneously in all wombs,
one should cast it into the womb of Vagishvari with the left rising mudra. "Om Ham Ham Ham, homage to the Self" — one should also worship with this and satisfy fivefold.
In all other wombs one should do purification of the body with the heart-mantra. Here there is no male-engendering rite, as even the bodies of women and others are possible;
or the parting of the hair; the limbs of gods as of the body; one should do the birth with the head, abhorring the bodies of all the embodied.
Likewise one should contemplate the authority of these with the Shiva-atom; enjoyment with the armor-mantra, with the weapon in the nature of the object;
one should contemplate the form of delusion and non-difference called dissolution. With Shiva the purification of the channels, with the heart the cleansing of principles;
one should offer five and five oblations in order at the impregnation and the rest, for release from the bonds of illusion, impurity, action and the rest.
Having made atonement with the heart afterward one should offer a hundred oblations; by restraining the power of impurity and loosening the bonds,
with the weapon mantra ending in svaha one should offer five and five oblations; of the bond beginning and ending with illusion, with seven repetitions of the weapon-mantra
one should cut it with scissors, with the weapon of the age, thus: "Om Hum, to the bond of the digit Nivritti, hum phat." Having completed the binding and with both hands and the arrow-atom,
having released and made it round, one should hold it in a ladle full of ghee. One should burn it by the following-digit weapon, by the sole weapon, to ash.
Having given five oblations one should do it for the release from noose and goad. "Om Hah, to the weapon, hum phat" — then one should do expiation with eight weapon-oblations.

Then having invoked the Creator one should worship and satisfy; then "Om Ham, pure Brahma of sound and touch, accept, svaha" — with three oblations one should hand over his authority: "Brahma, of him whose sins are all burnt, this beast, by you
he should not again stay for bondage" — thus one should have Shiva's command heard. Then, having dismissed the Creator, slowly by the right channel,
by the mudra of withdrawal, by retention, with one's own self, resembling the moon's disc joined with Rahu in one part,
having taken, one should join to the thread by exhalation called rising; having worshipped, like a drop of nectar in the arghya-vessel,
having dismissed the parents one should give with the Shiva-atom ending in vaushat. For fullness the rule is full; Nivritti is thus purified.
Gokarna, Bhadrakarna, Svarnaksha and Sthanu, Ajesha, Sarvajna, Bhasvara, Sudanantara,
Subahu, Mattarupi, Vishala and Jatila; Raudra and Pingalaksha, then Kaladamshtri;
Vidura, Ghora, Prajapatya, Hutashana; Kamarupi, Kala, Karna and Bhayanaka;
Matanga and Pingala, Hara called Dhatri; Shankukarna, Vidhana, Shrikantha and Chandrashekhara.

With this also the ends are told, then the words also: "Pervader; Om formless; Om Pramatha; Om radiance; Om light; Om Person; Om Agni; Om smokeless; Om ashless; Om beginningless; Om manifold; Om Dhudhu; Om Bhuh; Om Bhuvah; Om Svah; endless, source of end, Shiva, Sharva, Supreme Self, Maheshvara, Mahadeva, lord of true being, of great radiance, lord of yoga, release, first, all, all of all" — thirty-two words; in seed state three mantras: Vamadeva, Shiva, Shikha.
Gandhari and Sushumna, the two channels; and two winds, called Samana and Udana; the tongue and anus the senses;
taste is the object; form, sound, touch and taste the qualities; the orb round, marked with a lotus, white;
the cause in the dream-state station is the Garuda-bannered. Having contemplated all worlds and the rest as ending in Pratishtha,

one should enter the thread in the body with one's own mantra and release this: "Om Ham Khim Ham, to the bond of the digit Pratishtha, Om phat" ending in svaha, by this inhalation with the goad-mudra one should draw; then "Om Ham Hrum Hram Hrum, to the bond of the digit Pratishtha, Hrum phat" by this with the mudra of withdrawal, by retention taking from the thread of the channel below the heart; with "Om Ham Hrum Hram Ham, homage to the bond of the digit Pratishtha," by the rising mudra, by exhalation, one should place it in the pot; "Om Ham Him, homage to the bond of the digit Pratishtha" — having worshipped with this, having made present with three oblations ending in svaha, then "Om Ham, homage to Vishnu" having invoked Vishnu, worshipped and satisfied: "Vishnu, in this your authority I shall initiate the seeker of liberation;
be favorable to us" — thus one should inform Vishnu. Then the goddess Vagishvari and the lord of speech as before,
having invoked, worshipped and satisfied, one should strike the disciple on the chest: "Om Ham Ham Ham phat" — one should enter with this and then divide the consciousness
joined with the bond by the weapon, by the eldest, with the goad-mudra: "Om Ham Ham Haum Hrum phat svaha" having drawn with the heart, and enclosed by that same,

having taken it, with the one ending in "namah" one should unite it to one's own Self: "Om Ham Ham Haum, homage to the Self"; as before having imagined the union of parents, with the one called rising,
by the left one with that, one should cast it into the goddess's womb: "Om Ham Ham Ham, homage to the Self." In the arising of the body, thus with the heart, thus with the head at birth,
with the crest for authority, with the armor-atom for enjoyment; in the purification of principles, with the heart, as before for impregnation,
for the loosening of the bond with the head, thus having atoned one should repeat a hundred; likewise for the separation from the bond, then with consecrated scripture
one should cut with the weapon, scissors with the digit-seed: "Om Hrim, to the bond of the digit Pratishtha, Hah phat" — having released, made round with the bond-mantra as before,
having put in a ladle full of ghee, one should offer with the digit-weapon alone; one should offer five with the weapon to release the sprouts of bonds;
for the prevention of atonement then one should give eight oblations: "Om Hah, to the weapon, Hrum phat." Having invoked Hrishikesha and made worship and satisfaction,
one should do the handing over of authority by the previously stated rule: "Om Ham, accept the fee of taste, svaha; this beast whose bonds are all burnt, Hari, by you
he should not stay as binding" — thus one should have Shiva's command heard. Then having dismissed Govinda and joined the knowledge-self,
resembling the moon's disc with half seen, arm released, having made the Self settled by the mudra of withdrawal and the rising mudra,

having joined and placed on the thread a drop of water as before, having dismissed the parents of the fire worshipped with flowers and the rest, one should give the full oblation by rule; Pratishtha too is purified.
Striking, cutting, entering there and joining; having drawn, one should seize with knowledge from the region of the heart;
having placed in the Self and taken the digit one should establish it in the pit. Having invoked Rudra the cause and informed regarding the child,
having made the invoking of the parents, one should strike the child on the heart; having entered with the earlier mantra one should unite it to its Self.
Having drawn and taken it, by the earlier-stated rule one should unite it to the Self; one should unite with the left in the womb having taken it from the twelve-ending.
One should make completion of the body and the authority of birth; enjoyment and dissolution, purification of channels and cleansing of principles,
for release from all bonds of impurity, action and the rest; having atoned by rule one should offer a hundred oblations.
By the weapon the loosening of the bond, the power of impurity hidden; their cutting, crushing and likewise rounding,
burning, the absence of its letters, then the expiation is told; the invocation of Rudrani, worship, offering of form and scent.

Om Hrim, accept the fee of form and scent, Rudra, svaha — having made heard Shambhu's command, having dismissed Rudra the cause, having placed consciousness in the Self one should place it on the bond-thread.
Having placed the bindu on the head, then one should dismiss the parents. One should give the full oblation by rule, completing the whole procedure.
By the rule stated before, striking and the rest should be done in knowledge; with one's own seed-syllable there is the distinction — thus the knowledge is purified.
Having drawn, one should seize from the mouth-thread of peace; having placed in the Self and taken the digit one should establish it in the pit.
